name: European Long distance path E1 - Norway (south)
description_md:
The European Long distance path E1 in Norway is a waymarked hiking route covering a distance of 1035.7 km. It is signposted as the E1 and belongs to the international waymarked hiking network.

This hard route involves 24676 m of ascent and 24599 m of descent, requiring about 325 hours of walking time on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The line matches the official route published by turrutebasen. During the journey, the path passes Roros within 100 m and Røros Mining Town and the Circumference within 100 m.
